title: Exact component direct image and its ordinary adjunction unit
statement:
Let $W$ be a w-contractible affine scheme [sk-def-pe-wlocal], let $S=\pi_0(W)$ with its profinite quotient topology, and let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Use the small pro-etale site and compatible coefficient universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Give $\operatorname{Prof}/S$ finite jointly surjective coverings, let $q_S$ be its slice projection to the condensed topos, put $\Lambda_S=q_S^*\Lambda$, and let $\pi_W$ be the component morphism with $p_W=q_S\pi_W$ [lem-zl-component-relative-profinite-site]. Write $F_W=\pi_W^*$ on module sheaves and on their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with coefficient identification $F_W\Lambda_S=p_W^*\Lambda$. Let $G_W=\pi_{W,*}$ on module sheaves, with scalar action induced by the unit on coefficient rings, and use the module adjunction $F_W\dashv G_W$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction]. For every extremally disconnected profinite $E\to S$, the component test scheme $W_E=W\times_S E$ of [lem-zl-affine-component-site-projection] is w-contractible affine, its component space is canonically $E$, its closed point locus is $W^c\times_S E$, and the maps on local rings from $W$ are isomorphisms. There are natural evaluation identities
$$(G_WN)(E)=N(W_E),\qquad (G_WF_WM)(E)=M(E),$$
for every module sheaf $N$ over $W$ and $M$ over $\operatorname{Prof}/S$; the ordinary adjunction unit $\eta_M:M\to G_WF_WM$ evaluates under the second identity to $\operatorname{id}_{M(E)}$. The functor $G_W$ is exact on module sheaves and $\eta_M$ is an isomorphism for every $M$. These assertions include $E=\varnothing$ and $W=\varnothing$; no finiteness or discreteness assumption on coefficients or module sheaves is made.

proof.text: Recover the section ring sheaf of the internal condensed coefficient, with the canonical monoid isomorphism given by ring reconstruction. Apply generic component coefficient comparison to W and the spectrum of an algebraic closure of the universe lift of Q. The field component morphism is an equivalence. This supplies L, its adjunction and the coefficient isomorphism required in the statement. All choices are determined up to the relevant adjunction-compatible isomorphism.

source.place: Proposition 4.3(1), proof of the unit equivalence by extremally disconnected tests and w-contractibility of X times over pi_0(X) E; Bhatt–Scholze Lemmas 2.2.8, 2.4.8.

proof.text: Apply the affine component-site theorem to $W$: $W_E$ is affine ind-etale over $W$, its underlying ringed space is $|W|\times_S E$ with the inverse-image structure sheaf, and $\pi_0(W_E)=E$. In particular its local-ring maps from $W$ are isomorphisms. The w-local component theorem identifies $W^c$ homeomorphically with $S$ and gives the unique closed specialization $c(w)$ of each $w$. In the pullback space $(w,e)$ specializes to $(c(w),e)$: specialization is coordinatewise in a product and restricts to a subspace. The latter point is closed, since both its coordinates are closed. Conversely every closed point must equal this specialization. Thus $(W_E)^c=W^c\times_S E$, a closed subset, and every point has exactly one closed specialization. The local ring at $(c,e)$ is that at $c$ in $W$, hence strictly henselian. Since $E$ is extremally disconnected, the definition now gives that $W_E$ is w-contractible.

source.place: Proposition 4.3(1), proof: the paragraph beginning "As X times over pi_0 X S"; BS Lemmas 2.1.4, 2.2.8, 2.4.8

proof.text: For arbitrary ring sheaves A and B and a scalar map A → componentPush B, module pushforward is a right adjoint by the universe-compatible existence theorem, hence preserves finite limits; additivity is sectionwise. For any module epimorphism, its underlying abelian morphism is epi since module forgetful preserves finite colimits. Evaluation on W_E is surjective because W_E is affine w-contractible and hence weakly contractible. Stonean presentations give covering singletons in the coherent profinite slice. This makes the pushed-forward abelian morphism locally surjective, hence epi. The forgetful functor reflects epimorphisms, so pushforward preserves epis. An additive functor preserving kernels and epimorphisms preserves homology and therefore finite colimits.

source.place: Proposition 4.3(1), proof of the unit equivalence by extremally disconnected tests and w-contractibility of X times over pi_0(X) E; Bhatt–Scholze Lemmas 2.2.8, 2.4.8.

proof.text: Apply the Stonean-test module unit theorem to the coefficient adjunction constructed in step 1. Cover any profinite slice object by its Stonean presentation. Sectionwise bijectivity on these covering objects implies local injectivity and local surjectivity of the underlying abelian sheaf unit, hence it is an isomorphism. The faithful module forgetful functor reflects this isomorphism. This proves the unit is invertible for every module.

source.place: Proposition 4.3(1), proof of the unit equivalence by extremally disconnected tests and w-contractibility of X times over pi_0(X) E; Bhatt–Scholze Lemmas 2.2.8, 2.4.8.

proof.text: Form the second evaluation natural isomorphism by whiskering the inverse of the unit natural isomorphism with evaluation, together with functor associators and the left unitor. Its composite with the evaluated unit is identity by the inverse law. Compatibility with restrictions in E is exactly naturality of the inverse module-sheaf morphism. The direct evaluation definition is already the identity with restriction of scalars. No nonempty hypothesis was used, so the same proof includes empty W and E.

HRS Prop 4.3(1), its proof and the (4.1) construction were checked by pdftotext; all 20 cited nodes were read and exist unmerged. The statement is unchanged and true (small case: W strictly henselian local, with E=∅ and W=∅ also checked). There are no new nodes. It is not a duplicate: the sibling lem-sfb-component-pullback-unbounded-evaluation only evaluates F_W and does not state exactness of G_W or that the unit is an iso. Step 1: the closed points of W_E are exactly the pairs (w,e) with w closed, the unique closed specialization of (w,e) is (c(w),e), and the stalks are those of W, so W_E is w-contractible. Step 2: the clopen partition glues to a section of the finite qcqs cover, which is the hypothesis of the affine component-site evaluation. Step 3: Hom_W(W_E,W_D)=Hom_S(E,D) via the stalk-isomorphism lifting node, so (E,id) is initial and the unit is the identity coprojection followed by sheafification (00VE/00WX). Step 4: module unit m↦1⊗η(m), identified by a⊗m↦am. Step 5: exactness from det-pe-wc-sections-exact on W_E plus Stonean covers and the general-site epi criterion. Step 6: descent through E×_TE using injectivity proved on every profinite T. Step 7: empty cases are elementary. proof_deps equals the union of uses, steps are under 2000 characters, there is no SGA, and the 10 declared tool_uses are accepted as generic tools. Maintainer note: step 3 reads the 'canonical identification' of lem-zl-affine-component-site-projection as the sheafification comparison at split qcqs W. That node's proof proves exactly this, but its statement should later name the map explicitly.
